problem_statement: Consulting firms suffer from high Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR) for bugs requiring both stale internal knowledge (past fixes) and up-to-date external knowledge (API changes). This agent automates the 90% research and code execution effort, requiring Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) sign-off for deployment.
architecture_overview: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) Orchestrator manages the end-to-end bug fix workflow, integrating Jira, GitHub, a proprietary MongoDB RAG tool, and the Tavily Search MCP tool.

orchestration_framework.name: LastMile AI mcp-agent
orchestration_framework.purpose: Primary Orchestrator, Reflection Loop Manager, State Handler, and Tool Client.

llm_model.name: GPT-4o / Claude 3.5 Sonnet
llm_model.purpose: Code Generation, Synthesis of Hybrid RAG Context, Reasoning for Reflection.

internal_knowledge_tool.name: MongoDB Atlas Vector Search RAG
internal_knowledge_tool.purpose: Stores proprietary past ticket resolutions (organizational memory) as vector embeddings for semantic search.

external_knowledge_tool.name: Tavily Search MCP Server
external_knowledge_tool.purpose: Provides real-time, AI-optimized web search results for API deprecations and library updates.

jira.purpose: Webhook listener for ticket creation and API client for status updates/comments.

github.purpose: Clones repo, creates branches, runs tests, and merges code.

frontend_ui.name: Streamlit
frontend_ui.purpose: Displays Agent Trace Log and serves the Human-in-the-Loop Approval Dashboard.

workflow_steps.name: Trigger & Preparation
workflow_steps.details: Client creates Jira ticket. **Jira Webhook** triggers a **Flask listener** which activates the **MCP Orchestrator**. Orchestrator changes Jira status to **IN PROGRESS**, pulls the code, creates a new Git branch, and runs the initial test suite to confirm failure (F→P test Fails).

workflow_steps.name: Hybrid Knowledge Retrieval (RAG)
workflow_steps.details: Orchestrator initiates parallel queries: 1. Calls **MongoDB RAG** (Vector Search) for related internal fix history. 2. Calls **Tavily Search MCP Server** for up-to-date external facts (e.g., library release notes). Contexts are combined for the Coder LLM.

workflow_steps.name: Code Generation & Reflection Loop
workflow_steps.details: Coder LLM generates patch. **Code Execution Tool** runs **F→P** (fix validation) and **P→P** (regression) tests. **IF FAIL:** The failure traceback is fed back to the Coder LLM for a maximum of 3 retries (Reflection).

workflow_steps.name: Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) Hand-off
workflow_steps.details: **IF SUCCESS:** Orchestrator updates Jira status to **IN REVIEW**. Posts a comment with the summary and a URL to the **Approval UI**. The full audit trail is logged in MongoDB's Audit Collection.

workflow_steps.name: Deployment & Finalization
workflow_steps.details: Developer clicks **APPROVE** in the UI. Orchestrator executes `git merge` via **GitHub Tool**, updates Jira status to **DONE**, and logs the time saved.

key_panels.name: Agent Trace Log (Transparency)
key_panels.content: Real-time, color-coded feed showing every tool call, RAG retrieval snippet, and LLM reasoning step. *Crucial for winning the 'trust' factor.*

key_panels.name: Code Diff & Test Report
key_panels.content: Side-by-side view of the proposed patch and a clear Pass/Fail table for F→P and P→P tests (all must be green).

key_panels.name: Approval Zone
key_panels.content: Large, unmistakable [🟢 APPROVE & MERGE] button and a prominent display of the estimated time saved (e.g., '3.5 Hours Saved').

sponsor_alignment_pitch.mongodb_win: Serves as the **Proprietary Knowledge Base**, providing the unique, competitive advantage (past, high-value fixes) that general LLMs lack.
sponsor_alignment_pitch.tavily_win: Provides the **Real-time Factual Layer** necessary for reliability, ensuring the generated fix addresses the absolute latest API changes and external library updates.
sponsor_alignment_pitch.overall_win: The **MCP Orchestrator** is the backbone, demonstrating **enterprise reliability** and a scalable, production-ready **Human-in-the-Loop** system for automation.

estimated_cost.llm_api: <$5 (Minimal token usage for the demo run)
